violated_contract: When an external memory resend reuses an evidence id derived without every immutable source field, a changed device or source version may collide with active evidence. A text-identical active memory must be returned unchanged; a different source occupying an evidence id must not be overwritten or turn the user-facing create into a server error.
canonical_prevention: Resolve a content-derived memory id against a live identical non-rejected row before proposing evidence, reissue occupied non-conversation evidence ids deterministically from the proposed source identity while retaining the original row id when available, and bound conflict retries so concurrent identical submissions converge on one row. Preserve genuine conflicts and privacy deletion fences.
